extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to demonstrate the in-scope issue by looking for any claim asserting a rate over the complete 96-station scheduled network paired with the 72-station denominator. None exists: the selected result (results/report.md L8) is worded 'Among signal-eligible stations', the target population line (L4) restricts scope to the 72 eligible stations, and the task itself (task.md L1) asks for the rate conditional on passing the screen. Per the scope definition, a target explicitly conditional on the retained subset is not this issue; arithmetic 18/72 = 25% is internally consistent with the input counts (18 + 54 = 72).
